speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

text: I've had this cough going on for about four weeks now. It's pretty productive, and the phlegm is yellowish, but I haven't coughed up any blood. speaker: Doctor
